entries.27964f88da0409ae: The Human Resources Support Business provides employment support that connects people who could potentially work, as new workers, with small and medium-sized enterprises struggling with labor shortages. It operates the job site "Mama Works," which specializes in "work-from-home" jobs, and the number of registered members exceeded 650,000 as of August 2025. Job advertisements generate revenue in the form of listing fees according to the listing period, and consulting on building operational workflows that enable work using cloud workers generates revenue according to the contract period. The Company itself has used cloud workers since 2015 and, as of August 2025, had outsourcing contracts with about 3,500 people. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were up 24.0% from the previous year. In addition to the Company, Makev Holdings Inc. and Kaimaku Inc. carry out this business.
entries.39be4ff428b53940: The Sales Support Business uses the sales-related database obtained through the Group's business activities and the proprietary sales support system "Sales Crowd" to provide test marketing execution support suited to the products and services of client companies that mainly operate businesses targeting corporate customers. Over roughly 1 year, it verifies sales plans from various angles and finds highly effective patterns, supporting improvements in clients' sales results and productivity. A sales plan consists of a target list and a talk script, and the Company handles all of the preparation. As of the end of August 2025, the cumulative number of companies supported was more than 15,500, and plans are drawn up from the database that accumulates that data. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were up 22.7% from the previous year, the largest of the 3 service categories. In addition to the Company, Sales Crowd Inc., Addlast Inc. and Unique Career Inc. carry out this business.
